entity_step_description: Add the person or business details.
entity_about_description: An accounting entity is the person or business whose records you keep.
entity_options_error_text: We couldn’t load countries and currencies. Please try again.
financial_year_about_description: Periods divide your financial year into smaller date ranges. You choose their names; dates and the current period are calculated automatically.
reports_step_description: Name your reporting setup, then choose its currency and periods.
reports_about_description: Each period is the date range a report covers. You choose its name; dates and the current period are calculated automatically.
income_categories_step_description: Select the categories you want to create.
income_categories_about_description: Income categories group similar earnings. Every category needs a parent; Drimsheet sets up the required parent groups automatically.
